title: Reconcile the fixed-asset register to the general ledger — Oakridge Foods
instructions: Oakridge Foods' fixed-asset register does not agree to PP&E in the general ledger at December 31. A staff accountant investigated and prepared the reconciliation below. Review it against the investigation notes. Tick every amount that is wrong and enter the correct amount. Enter decreases as negative numbers.

exhibits.title: Investigation notes
exhibits.content:
- Fixed-asset register, total cost: **$2,915,400**. General ledger PP&E, cost: **$2,985,000**.
- A **$26,000** parking-lot resurfacing (a land improvement with a 15-year life), completed December 30, was capitalized in the general ledger but not yet entered in the register.
- A forklift (cost **$18,500**; accumulated depreciation **$14,200**) was sold in November for **$5,000**. Fixed-assets staff removed it from the register. The cash was credited to a suspense account and no disposal entry was recorded in the general ledger.
- A **$25,100** payment to patch leaks in the warehouse roof, completed December 31, was capitalized in the general ledger. The patching did not extend the roof's life or add capacity. It is not in the register.
- No depreciation for the year relates to the resurfacing or the roof patching.

parts.prompt: Review the reconciliation of the fixed-asset register to the general ledger.

rows.label: Cost per fixed-asset register
rows.explanation: Agrees to the register total. **No error.**

rows.label: Parking-lot resurfacing (land improvement) not yet added to the register
rows.explanation: A land improvement is a depreciable capital asset. The general ledger is right; the register must add it. **No error.**

rows.label: PP&E cost per general ledger
rows.explanation: Agrees to the trial balance. **No error.**

rows.label: Forklift sold in November, disposal not recorded in the general ledger
rows.explanation: The forklift is gone from the register but still in the general ledger, so the ledger is **overstated**. The adjustment is **−18,500**.

rows.label: Roof patching capitalized in the general ledger
rows.explanation: Patching leaks restores the roof to its normal condition without extending its life — ordinary repairs and maintenance are **expensed**. The ledger must remove it: **−25,100**.

rows.label: Adjusted general ledger cost
rows.explanation: 2,985,000 − 18,500 − 25,100 = **2,941,400**, which agrees to the adjusted register.

parts.prompt: Determine the effect of the general ledger corrections on pretax income.

rows.label: Net increase (decrease) in pretax income from all corrections
